Creativity, data, and AI in the same operating system.

I'm Erfan Hasanzadeh, a digital marketer working at the intersection of creativity, data, and AI. How I Work

A practical system from audit to scale.

Discovery & Data Audit

Deep dive into your business, audience, and current digital footprint.

2

Strategy & AI Modeling

Build a data backed plan using AI tools, market analysis, and competitor research.

3

Execution & Testing

Launch campaigns, A/B test creatives, and track every variable obsessively.

4

Optimize & Scale

Double down on what works, cut what doesn't, and scale sustainably.

Why It Matters

Your digital presence is already being compared.

Buyers check first

Most people research a business online before they ever reach out. If your presence is unclear, they move on before you get a chance.

AI changes the pace

Teams using AI to research, test, and report move faster than teams that still do it by hand.

Guessing has a cost

A strategy without a feedback loop is just a guess with a budget attached to it.

Your competitors are already using AI and data to make smarter decisions. Every day without a clear digital strategy is revenue left on the table.
